deltas.description: Current llama.cpp exposes an mtmd encoded-embedding seam before image-chunk decode, making one-encode reuse physically testable.
Introduced PEH candidate to make embedding lifetime/reuse explicit, versioned, provenance-bound and falsifiable.
Dedicated light embedding encoder remains viable because strong VLM embedding systems use explicit embedding objectives; raw Qwen geometry is not assumed calibrated.
Current Qwen3.5-4B config does not expose enabled DeepStack visual indexes; a free standard multi-level tap is not available as assumed route.
Runtime batch/ubatch/offload/backend configuration added to semantic-correctness benchmark metadata and differential matrix.
PAR/EAP memory-benefit lane is explicitly blocked from promotion until independent Frank experience-dose fixtures can produce N=0..64 curves and direct-memory controls.
